Package de.eldoria.eldoutilities.updater

Class Updater<V extends UpdateResponse,T extends UpdateData<V>>

java.lang.Object
de.eldoria.eldoutilities.updater.Updater<V,T>
Type Parameters:
T - type of Updater
All Implemented Interfaces:
Runnable, Listener
Direct Known Subclasses:
LynaUpdateChecker, SpigotUpdateChecker
public abstract class Updater<V extends UpdateResponse,T extends UpdateData<V>> extends Object implements Listener, Runnable
Base implementation for Updater.

Checks and downloads run on the updater's own thread, one after another. reconfigure(UpdateData) hands the updater new settings, for example after a config reload, and stop() ends it.

    • lyna

      public static Updater<LynaUpdateResponse,LynaUpdateData> lyna(LynaUpdateData data)
      Create a new lyna update check.

      A Lyna update check is made to work together with a Lyna instance.

      Additionally, a build.data file is required, which is created by the publishdata plugin.

      With auto update enabled, new stable releases are downloaded: free products directly, premium products with an upgrade token from the account area of the lyna instance, see LynaUpdateDataBuilder.tokenStore(UpgradeTokenStore).

      Parameters:
      data - lyna plugin data
      Returns:
      Updater instance

      public final CompletableFuture<Boolean> download()
      Downloads the available update on request, as offered by the download button of the update message.

      Runs on the update checker thread and does nothing unless offersDownload() allows the last checked version.

      Returns:

    • updatesAutomatically

      protected boolean updatesAutomatically()
      Whether the last checked version may be installed without anybody asking for it, when auto update is enabled. Otherwise, the update is announced and, if offersDownload() allows it, offered for download.

    • isMajorUpdate

      public boolean isMajorUpdate()
      Whether the last checked version is a new major version, which may not be compatible with the installed setup. A major update is never installed automatically, is marked in the update message, and its download has to be confirmed.
      Returns:
      true for a major update

    • offersDownload

      protected boolean offersDownload()
      Whether the last checked version can be downloaded on request through download(). Updaters that implement update() should allow it.
      Returns:
      true when a download button is offered

    • checkUpdate

      protected abstract Optional<V> checkUpdate(T data)
      The check method will be called after the constructor is called.

      This method should be implemented as follows:

      Retrieve the latest version of the plugin from any update service.

      return the latest version or a empty optional if the version could not be checked.

      Parameters:
      data - data for plugin updates
      Returns:
      empty optional if the version could not be checked or the latest version.

    • reconfigure

      public final CompletableFuture<Void> reconfigure(T data)
      Replaces the settings of the updater, for example after the plugin reloaded its config.

      The current notification is removed and a check with the new settings runs right away, so an update that the new settings allow to install automatically is installed then. An update that was already downloaded is not downloaded again.

      Parameters:
      data - new settings
      Returns:
      future completing once the check with the new settings is done

    • isAutoUpdate

      public final boolean isAutoUpdate()
      Whether updates are installed automatically: as configured, unless an admin switched it on in chat since.
      Returns:
      true when automatic updates are on

    • offersAutoUpdate

      public final boolean offersAutoUpdate()
      Whether admins are offered to switch automatic updates on in chat. That needs a hook to store the decision, automatic updates being off, and nobody having chosen not to be asked again.
      Returns:
      true when automatic updates are offered

    • enableAutoUpdate

      public final CompletableFuture<Boolean> enableAutoUpdate()
      Switches automatic updates on, as chosen by an admin in chat. The plugin's hook receives AutoUpdateDecision.ENABLED, and a found update that may be installed automatically is installed right away. Does nothing unless automatic updates are offered.
      Returns:
      future completing with whether automatic updates are on afterward

    • declineAutoUpdate

      public final CompletableFuture<Void> declineAutoUpdate()
      Stops offering automatic updates, as chosen by an admin in chat. The plugin's hook receives AutoUpdateDecision.NEVER_ASK. Does nothing unless automatic updates are offered.
      Returns:
      future completing once the decision is applied

    • stop

      public final void stop()
      Stops the updater for good: no further checks run, and the notification is removed. Use it when the plugin is disabled or its config switches update checks off.

    • start

      public void start()
      Start the update check thread.

      This will check every 6 hours if an update is available.
